facts.fact: President Chapo promulgated the Cybersecurity Law, protecting networks, information systems and critical infrastructure, with a regulatory body and penalties up to 160 minimum wages; reported by Lusa/Club of Mozambique, date is the article's published date.
President Chapo promulgated the Cybercrime Law in the same decree, strengthening prevention, investigation and punishment of digital crimes; date is the article's published date.

slug: 2026-04-17 Mozambique parliament unanimously approves Cyber Security Law

facts.fact: Parliament unanimously approved the Cyber Security Law, making INCM technical coordinator for cyberspace security and creating a Cyber Security Fund; the government had submitted the proposal the previous Thursday.
In the same session parliament approved the separate Cybercrime Law, which specifies offences and penalties.
Communications minister Muchanga said the government has approved the Cybersecurity Law and the Cybercrime Law and that implementation is mandatory for companies operating critical infrastructure.

facts.fact: DLA Piper reports a Cybersecurity Bill (version 6 of 15 September 2023, on INTIC's site) still under discussion, to make INTIC the national cybersecurity authority and set fines.
